newsitem.title: USA: Texas Util sees Texas nuke restart Sat..
newsitem.headline: Texas Util sees Texas nuke restart Sat..

text.p: Texas Utilities said Friday it expected its 1,150 megawatt Comanche Peak nuclear unit two in Glen Rose, Texas, to begin restart early Saturday.
A company spokeswoman said the unit would likely restart at about 0300 CDT/0800 EDT.
The unit tripped off line at 0306 CDT Friday due to a problem with the service air compressor motor.

Texas Utilities' other Comanche Peak unit, also with a generating capacity of 1,150 MW, is currently shut for refueling. The unit is expected to return to service near the third week in November, she said.
